description: Phase 1 diagnostics are now complete. Yusuf provided full access to ACCHCO’s terminal operating system data, revealing a yard utilization peak of 94%. Felix’s simulation confirmed the congestion is driven by poor block allocation rather than lack of space, and re‑zoning could recover roughly 20% of effective capacity. The team is moving into Phase 2 redesign, with a request for two days of operations‑team support in early May.

timeline.entry: Phase 1 diagnostics started, with full access to ACCHCO's terminal operating system data revealing an initial yard utilization peak of 94% (well above the 75% best‑practice threshold) and Felix beginning to build the simulation model.

Today the kickoff in Alexandria initiated Phase 1 diagnostics, and with full access to ACCHCO’s terminal operating system data a key finding of 94% peak yard utilization was identified, leading Felix to begin building the simulation model.

Phase 1 diagnostics were completed, revealing that yard congestion is caused by poor block allocation rather than insufficient space and that re‑zoning could recover roughly 20% of effective capacity.

Phase 1 diagnostics were completed, confirming that yard congestion is caused by poor block allocation rather than lack of space and that approximately 20% of effective capacity can be recovered through re-zoning.
